author: Grace Samels
title: Auburn Mayor Dave Clark seeks second term - NewsBreak
text:
By Grace Samels ,
1 hours ago
DEKALB COUNTY, Ind. (WANE) -- Auburn Mayor Dave Clark has announced his intention to seek his second term as mayor.
Thursday, Clark, a Republican, announced in a Facebook post that he is planning to run for reelection as mayor in the 2027 primary elections.
"After a lot of thought and conversations with family, friends and members of our community, I've decided to seek reelection as your Mayor of Auburn in 2027," his Facebook post read. "Serving this community over the past three years has been an honor and a responsibility I don't take lightly. We've accomplished a lot together, and I know there is still more work to do. I believe in Auburn, the people who make it special and the direction we're headed. My commitment remains the same: lead with integrity, be responsible with your tax dollars and always put our community first. I would appreciate your support and respectfully ask for your vote on May 4, 2027. Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to serve. Auburn's best days are still ahead!"
Clark is serving his first term as Auburn mayor after previously working as a real estate agent.
